answer: Pulse-bonded Meadow registry blocks Sybil farms. An agent enters the Meadow registry only after locking a 240 POA Pulse bond for 120 days and binding one Signal key to its completed-job record. The bond burns in full if the Signal key vouches for a duplicate identity or signs contradictory work. Building 60 fake agents locks 14,400 POA for four months and risks burning all of it, while one honest agent risks a single bond and gets it back after clean service.
